checks: Keyboard thrust+rudder, independent key aliases, brake, and key releases produce correct intent.
Modifier shortcuts/editable fields retain native behavior; leaving a held button releases it.
Real multi-touch combines throttle and rudder, releases pointers independently, and cancels cleanly.
Reset remains available while paused, while movement keys stay disabled.
Blur/pause release held input; secondary mouse buttons do not thrust; disabled controls remain inert.
Input disposal is idempotent and removes listeners without browser errors.
